title: Strings
description: Learn to manipulate text in Python.

sections.title: What is a String?
sections.markdown: A string is a sequence of characters. In Python, they are enclosed in quotes.
key_points: What is a String? is a core concept to understand
Practice applying What in real code

sections.title: Indexing and Slicing
sections.markdown: Strings support indexing (accessing single characters) and slicing (extracting substrings).
key_points: Indexing and Slicing is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Indexing in real code

sections.title: Immutability
sections.learning_objective: Understand that strings cannot be changed.
sections.markdown: Strings are immutable, meaning once created, they cannot be modified in place.
key_points: Immutability is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Immutability in real code

sections.title: String Methods
sections.markdown: Python provides many useful methods for transforming strings.
key_points: String Methods is a core concept to understand
Practice applying String in real code

sections.title: Strip, Split, Join
sections.markdown: Use strip to remove whitespace, split to break into a list, and join to combine a list into a string.
key_points: Strip, Split, Join is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Strip, in real code

sections.title: Replace, Find, In
sections.markdown: Use replace to swap substrings, find to locate index, and 'in' for membership.
key_points: Replace, Find, In is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Replace, in real code

sections.title: F-strings and Formatting
sections.markdown: An f-string allows embedding expressions directly into string literals, replacing older formatting methods.
key_points: F-strings and Formatting is a core concept to understand
Practice applying F-strings in real code

sections.title: Reverse and Palindrome
sections.markdown: Reversing a string is easily done with slicing [::-1]. A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards.
key_points: Reverse and Palindrome is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Reverse in real code

sections.title: Anagram Pattern
sections.markdown: An anagram is formed by rearranging letters. Often solved by sorting or using character counts.
key_points: Anagram Pattern is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Anagram in real code

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.markdown: Forgetting that string methods return new strings rather than mutating.
key_points: Common Mistakes is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Common in real code

sections.title: Interview Points
sections.markdown: Be ready to implement a palindrome check, solve anagrams, or reverse strings in an interview setting.
key_points: Interview Points is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interview in real code
